tools.name: Semgrep
tools.command: bash security/scanners/application.sh REPORT_DIR full (pinned official JavaScript, TypeScript, Python security rules plus semgrep-local.yml; --metrics=off --disable-version-check --no-rewrite-rule-ids --jobs 2 --max-memory 2048 --json)
tools.coverage: All nonignored repository targets for official JS/TS/Python security rules. Full scan followed by fresh security Python rescan after agent edits stabilized.
limitations: Six partial parser warnings remain explicit. Default ignored build/dependency paths and three targets larger than 1 MB were skipped; no tracked JS/TS/Python source exceeds 1 MB.
Partial scan: 6 parser/timeout/other errors; see sanitized JSON.

tools.name: CodeQL
tools.command: LGTM_INDEX_INCLUDE=$'.\n.agents' codeql database create --language=javascript-typescript --build-mode=none --codescanning-config=security/configs/codeql.yml --threads=2 --ram=4096; codeql database analyze javascript-security-extended.qls --format=sarifv2.1.0 --threads=2 --ram=4096
tools.coverage: All 2001 eligible repository JavaScript/TypeScript source files, including hidden skill scripts; 105 security-extended queries.
limitations: The infrastructure agent subsequently made a one-line Node compatibility change in src/lib/auth-mode.ts; a focused Semgrep rescan of that final file reported 0 findings/0 errors. No original SAST finding involved that file.

tools.name: CodeQL
tools.command: codeql database create --language=python --build-mode=none --codescanning-config=security/configs/codeql.yml --threads=2 --ram=2048; codeql database analyze python-security-extended.qls --format=sarifv2.1.0 --threads=2 --ram=2048
tools.coverage: All 13 repository Python tooling files; 52 security-extended queries.
limitations: After the full Python CodeQL run, security/scanners/infrastructure.py changed only its generated-output exclusion from security/reports to security/(reports|runs). A fresh focused Semgrep scan using all 18 official Python security rule directories reported the same reviewed subprocess audit match and 0 errors. CodeQL was not rerun for this exclusion constant; its coverage counts describe the preceding source snapshot.

After the full Python CodeQL run, security/scanners/infrastructure-smoke.py was updated to reread Docker's ephemeral host port after restart and require the refreshed address to remain on 127.0.0.1 before its health check. A fresh focused Semgrep scan with all 18 official Python security rule directories reported 0 findings and 0 errors. CodeQL was not rerun for this local smoke-helper change; its coverage counts describe the preceding source snapshot.

After the full Python CodeQL run, security/report.py was updated to retain per-source deduplicated observations and select location/evidence/remediation from the remaining open component. A fresh focused Semgrep scan with all 18 official Python security rule directories reported 0 findings and 0 errors. CodeQL was not rerun for this local report aggregation change; its coverage counts describe the preceding source snapshot.

findings.description: User-authored split-test and release-gate expressions ran on the native backtracking regular-expression engine.
cwe_cve: CWE-400
findings.evidence: Official Semgrep detect-non-literal-regexp identified native dynamic matching. A safe isolated Node subprocess testing ^/(a+)+$ against a 34-character path exceeded 2 seconds and was terminated. Input validation previously checked syntax only.
findings.impact: An authorized project operator or repository change could exhaust the CPU budget for a backtest or release check. Length-limiting the pattern alone did not prevent exponential matching.
findings.recommendation: Use RE2JS matching and validate the RE2 feature set at configuration boundaries. Existing patterns using lookaround/backreferences require replacement; stored gate configuration now fails explicitly instead of silently dropping ignores.
verification: 2026-10-25: 1000-character adversarial input completes through public weigh entry point; unsupported backreference syntax is rejected by gate and split-test schemas.

Compatibility: RE2 matching preserves ordinary path search/anchors but intentionally rejects unsupported constructs. Recreate saved split tests with supported patterns; update relay-gate.json before retrying queued runs.

findings.description: Draft release notes used a predictable global temporary filename and followed pre-existing symlinks.
cwe_cve: CWE-377
CWE-59
findings.evidence: CodeQL js/insecure-temporary-file reported the Date.now-based filename. A subprocess regression pre-created a symlink at that predictable name; original CLI overwrote the synthetic victim. Git and gh were local stubs and no release was published.
findings.impact: A different local user able to precreate the guessed temporary path could cause an operator running --draft to overwrite a writable file or alter temporary release-note handling.
findings.recommendation: Create a random private directory, exclusively write the note file with mode 0600, and remove the directory in a finally block.
verification: 2026-10-25: regression failed before patch by observing victim content replaced; passes after with unchanged victim,0700 directory, 0600 file, and cleanup.
